course_name: RFID射頻辨識系統設計原理與應用
outline: 射頻辨識系統(Radio Frequency Identificatoin ; RFID )已被列為21世紀所發展的重要科技產業技術項目之一。可取代目前的條碼(Bar-code)資訊辨識系統，整合應用在門禁管理、保全管制、運輸監控、航空行李管控、圖書管理、物流管理及醫療管理等不同的相關領域上。因此本課程在使學生暸解RFID的基本設計原理及整合應用，並培養其實際設計的能力，進而能將之應用於不同的資訊領域上。
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Differentiation Features of RFID Systems
Week 3: Fundamental Operating Principles
Week 4: Physical Principles of RFID Systems(ANT Theory)
Week 5: Frequency Ranges and Radio Licensing Regulations
Week 6: Coding and modulation
Week 7: Data Integrity(Checksum ,CRC,…..Anticollision)
Week 8 : Data Security, Standardization
Week 9: The Architecture of Electronic Data Carriers, Reader
Week 10: Midterm
Week 11: report
Week 12: an experiment(LAB)
Week 13: an experiment(LAB)
Week 14: an experiment(LAB)
Week 15~18 Final Project
assessment:
Attendance:10%
Midterm exam:30 %
Final Project:30%
LAB & Assignments:20 %
A report:10 %
